author: CrazyWaffle5150
quote: The game is too restrictive regarding crime. You get a watented level from doing literally anything GTA related. Cars have trackers. Its hard to lose your wanted level. You can't replay missions. The game forces you into mundane tasks. The story is boring. To much forced socializing in the game. Cut scenes are to long. The flying mechanics are dumbed down. This is not a GTA game, its more like an imitation. GTA is dead to me. Can't pick up hookers. Invincible NPC's exist.
